$what: CANONICAL OUTPUT of every raster preset aeon actually ships, as Aurora's writer produced it BEFORE the empyrean c4a1da2 (boundary) re-vendor. test/formats/effects-preset-boundary.test.ts asserts the writer still produces exactly these bytes.
$why: A re-vendor that adds 58 leaves to the schema is exactly the change that can move canonical output for a document nobody touched, because serializeEffectsPreset runs canonicalizeBySchema over the WHOLE document against the WHOLE schema. 'Nothing shipped carries the key, so nothing is refused' is a claim about REFUSAL and says nothing about BYTES. Opening an untouched preset and saving it must not rewrite it; this file is what makes that a measurement instead of an assumption, at this re-vendor and at every one after.
$how_it_was_produced: Generated by running canonicalizeBySchema + canonicalJsonPretty (src/core/formats/effects/json-schema-subset.ts and src/core/formats/canonical-json.ts, NEITHER touched by this parcel - git log names 49dc5827 and 13e470ba as their last commits) against the PREVIOUS vendored schema, git blob 13473a43f3c5b2da45c4a029c477d3e57677d31e (empyrean dfd11bb). The same generator was then run against the NEW schema blob 0295b21b9f60e48685aff245695eaf7dc445ad59 (empyrean c4a1da2) and all six outputs were byte-identical, which is the finding this fixture preserves. The generator is deliberately built on the two UNCHANGED modules rather than on preset.ts, because preset.ts at the new revision cannot load the old schema at all (it reads $defs.boundary) - so a naive before/after would have compared the new codec to itself.
$not_a_claim_about_aeon: `documents` are aeon's bytes and `canonical` are AURORA's. They differ: aeon's generator writes its own key order, Aurora's writer sorts recursively (aeon docs/EDITOR_RASTER_PRESETS.md section 5, json.dumps(sort_keys=True, indent=2)). This file does NOT assert the two agree, and no row may read it that way. It asserts only that AURORA's answer has not moved.
$re_generate: Only when a re-vendor legitimately changes canonical output - which is a migration of every shipped preset and needs saying out loud, not a fixture refresh. Re-read the header of the row that consumes this before touching it.
